prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Miami after a car accident. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Miami for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — and I have two quick questions that will let me tailor recommendations: (1) Were you injured (minor, serious, catastrophic)? (2) Do you prefer a large national firm with lots of resources or a smaller local boutique that may give more direct attorney attention? If you want, tell me whether you need Spanish- or Portuguese-speaking counsel.

Below is a short list of Miami-area personal-injury law firms you should consider calling right away, with why each is worth contacting. These are not endorsements — call several to compare — and verify contact info/reviews before signing anything.

Suggested firms to call (and why)

- Morgan & Morgan (Florida offices)
  - Why: Largest plaintiff personal-injury firm in the U.S.; lots of resources for investigations, experts, and catastrophic cases; handles high volumes of car-accident claims and often works on contingency.
  - Good if you want a big staff and nationwide experience.

- Podhurst Orseck, P.A.
  - Why: Miami-based plaintiffs’ firm with a long history of high-value wrongful-death and catastrophic-injury verdicts/settlements and strong trial experience in Miami-Dade courts.
  - Good if your injuries are severe and you may need litigation-ready counsel.

- Colson Hicks Eidson
  - Why: South Florida firm experienced in auto collisions, serious injuries, and complex personal-injury litigation; known for trial experience and client service in Miami/Coral Gables.
  - Good if you want an experienced regional firm with deep plaintiff practice.

- Kanner & Pintaluga, P.A.
  - Why: Miami personal-injury and medical-malpractice firm focused on representing injured clients; local knowledge of Florida insurance and court procedures.
  - Good for clients who want a Miami-focused firm that routinely handles auto claims.

- Steinger, Greene & Feiner
  - Why: Florida-focused plaintiff personal-injury firm that handles motor-vehicle crashes and has a strong marketing presence and consumer-facing intake teams (contingency basis).
  - Good if you want a firm that takes many standard auto-injury cases and offers prompt intake/advocacy.

- Lytal, Reiter, Smith, Ivey & Fronrath (Lytal Reiter)
  - Why: Florida personal-injury firm with a track record in car-accident claims, experienced attorneys, and local presence across South Florida.
  - Good for local resources with experience in Miami-Dade cases.

How to pick among them (quick checklist when you call)
- Ask about their experience with Miami-Dade car-accident cases, and how many similar cases they’ve handled.
- Will an attorney (not only a paralegal) handle the case? Who will be your day-to-day contact?
- Trial experience: Have they taken similar cases to verdict? If so, ask for examples.
- Fee structure: confirm contingency fee percentage, costs they advance, and when you owe anything.
- Communication: how often will they update you and by what method?
- Medical liens and treatment: do they help arrange treatment/handle medical providers?
- Languages: ask if they have Spanish/Portuguese speakers if you need them.
- Expected timeline and likely outcomes given your injury level.

What to bring to the first call or free consult
- Date/time/place of crash, police report number (if any), insurance info (yours and the other driver’s), photos, medical records/summary of injuries and treatment, wage-loss info, and any witness contact info.

Other practical tips
- Call at least 3 firms to compare; most offer free consultations and work on contingency so you typically pay nothing up front.
- Confirm any firm’s current standing with the Florida Bar (www.floridabar.org) and check recent Google/Avvo/Martindale reviews.
- If you’re seriously injured, preserve medical records and get recommended treatment promptly — that protects your claim.

If you want, tell me your injury severity and whether you prefer big vs boutique, and I’ll reorder or add a few more firms that best fit your case and language needs.
